name: helios-llm-orchestrator
description: Loopback-only OpenRouter gateway and MCP server for routing tasks to multiple AI models.

scripts.check: node --check mcp/mcp-server.mjs && python3 -m py_compile agent/server.py agent/benchmark_registry.py scripts/refresh-benchmarks.py
scripts.test: npm run check && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
